say:0:1224102001:0.source_cn: 那个人好像是卢卡手下的贝拉。她难道是来找我们的？

say:3:1224103002:0.text: I'm surprised Lucca isn't at the office. Did something happen at the port?
say:3:1224103002:0.source_cn: 咦，卢卡居然不在血薇话事处？港口出了什么事吗？

say:4:1224103003:0.text: As just the messenger, I can't share anything more.
say:4:1224103003:0.source_cn: 我只负责传达命令，其他的无可奉告。

say:6:1224103004:1.text: Please come with me. Let's not keep Lucca waiting.
say:6:1224103004:1.source_cn: 请随我过去吧，别让二当家等太久。
say:6:1224103004:1.male: Please come with me. Let's not keep Lucca waiting.
say:6:1224103004:1.female: Please come with me. Let's not keep Lucca waiting.

say:1:1224105001:1.source_cn: 别紧张。请你们来，是有事需要你们帮忙。

say:3:1224105004:1.text: Since the port reopened, we've been looking to revive the trade in Rustport to foster development.
say:3:1224105004:1.source_cn: 锈锚港重新开放以后，血薇帮想尽快恢复贸易，寻找更多的发...

say:4:1224105005:1.text: Also, we aim to ditch the "posy parrots" nickname!
say:4:1224105005:1.source_cn: 顺便，也得甩掉“粉毛鹦鹉黑帮”的绰号！
say:4:1224105005:1.male: Also, we aim to ditch the "posy parrots" nickname!
say:4:1224105005:1.female: Also, we aim to ditch the "posy parrots" nickname!

say:6:1224105006:0.text: Well, that's probably the toughest of all...
say:6:1224105006:0.source_cn: 你最后说的这件事，应该是最困难的……

say:9:1224105008:0.text: The port was closed for so long that we're way behind on information compared to the outside world.
say:9:1224105008:0.source_cn: 港口封锁了太久，我们掌握的信息落后于外界很多。
say:9:1224105008:0.male: The port was closed for so long that we're way behind on information compared to the outside world.
say:9:1224105008:0.female: The port was closed for so long that we're way behind on information compared to the outside world.

say:10:1224105009:1.text: We need someone to help Rustport reconnect with the outside world.
say:10:1224105009:1.source_cn: 我们需要一个人，帮锈锚港重新建立与外界的联系。
say:10:1224105009:1.male: We need someone to help Rustport reconnect with the outside world.
say:10:1224105009:1.female: We need someone to help Rustport reconnect with the outside world.

say:11:1224105010:1.text: You're the only one who can help us.
say:11:1224105010:1.male: You're the only one who can help us.
say:11:1224105010:1.female: You're the only one who can help us.

say:13:1224105011:1.text: So, this is what you need <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s help with! Piece of cake!
say:13:1224105011:1.male: So, this is what you need <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s help with! Piece of cake!
say:13:1224105011:1.female: So, this is what you need <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s help with! Piece of cake!

say:14:1224105012:1.text: But, what exactly do you need us to do?
say:14:1224105012:1.source_cn: 不过，具体需要我们帮你们做什么呢？

say:16:1224105014:1.text: Just reach out when you have some downtime. We need to tackle the tasks one by one.
say:16:1224105014:1.source_cn: 等你们空闲下来再来找我。我们得一件件解决。

say:19:1224105003:1.text: It's Sonja's idea, and she's always the wise one.
say:19:1224105003:1.source_cn: 是索尼娅的嘱咐。她的话一向有道理。
